# Maersk Says Hopedale Chosen for Strategic Northeast Location

Wed, July 22, 2026 by Tyler Lawton

HOPEDALE – Global logistics company Maersk says Hopedale’s location played a key role in its decision to build a new $100 million fulfillment center in town.

As previously announced, the 617,000-square-foot facility is expected to create approximately 1,000 jobs and begin operations in August.

According to a company spokesperson speaking with the Milford Daily News, Hopedale was selected because of its “strategic location,” allowing Maersk to position inventory closer to customers as it continues expanding its North American logistics network.

## Fly like an eagle: Famous outfitters to invest $41M, create 200 jobs in Rowan County

Published 4:13 pm Friday, July 17, 2026

 By Staff Report 

 Aerial view of the location for American Eagle Outfitters' planned distribution center in Rowan County. - Submitted 

| Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... |
| --- |

SALISBURY — The Rowan Economic Development Council announced this week that American Eagle Outfitters will establish a new distribution center in Rowan County, investing $41 million and creating more than 200 full-time jobs.

The company will occupy a 472,890-square-foot facility at Innovation Logistics Center, located at 1415 Peeler Road in Salisbury. The facility is expected to begin operations in early 2027.

The new distribution center further expands Rowan County’s growing logistics and distribution industry while bringing new employment opportunities and private investment to the community.

Greg Edds, chairman of the Rowan County Board of Commissioners, said the company’s decision reflects the county’s continued momentum in attracting business investment.

#### New Kenosha hub significantly expands G10 Fulfillment’s Midwest warehouse capacity

 Posted in Kenosha County Economic Development 

A Delavan-based third-party logistics and fulfillment company has significantly expanded its Midwest warehouse capacity after moving into a new distribution facility in Kenosha.

G10 Fulfillment now occupies 315,000 square feet of a 600,000-square-foot building at 12345 38th St., just off Interstate 94. The move increases G10’s dock capacity to 65 doors from 30.

“The Midwest is probably the most important hub for us,” said co-founder and CEO Mark Becker, who was on hand Thursday for a ribbon-cutting at the facility. He pointed to the region’s freight infrastructure and its location along the trucking corridor between Chicago and Milwaukee.

Becker said the facility can handle nearly 7 acres of inventory under one roof. G10 shares the building with food manufacturer Eagle Foods.

ALO locating fulfillment and distribution operations in Southaven | Mississippi Development Authority

October 12, 2026

# ALO locating fulfillment and distribution operations in Southaven

- - Athletic apparel company creating more than 400 jobs 
- Project represents corporate investment of nearly $176 million

Jackson, Miss. (Oct. 12, 2026) – ALO, the fashion and lifestyle brand synonymous with premium studio-to-streetwear rooted in mind-body wellness, is locating a new national fulfillment and distribution center in Southaven. The project represents a corporate investment of nearly $176 million and will create more than 400 new jobs.

ALO is moving into an existing building and will occupy up to 1.2 million square feet, with the option to add returns processing operations at the facility.

The Mississippi Development Authority is providing assistance through the Mississippi Flexible Tax Incentive, or MFLEX, program. DeSoto County and the city of Southaven are assisting with the project, as well.

ALO began operations in August and plans to fill the new jobs by 2027.
